params.prompt: Create a production-ready RPG monster sprite sheet for a children's star-ocean fantasy game. TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, actual alpha channel, no checkerboard painted into the image. EXACT regular 3-column by 2-row grid of equal square cells. Exactly FIVE separate full-body creatures, one centered in each cell: top-left METAL, top-middle WOOD, top-right WATER, bottom-left FIRE, bottom-middle EARTH, bottom-right must remain completely empty and transparent. Every creature has a readable distinctive silhouette, looks toward the LEFT in a three-quarter view ready for a friendly battle, entire body/tail/claws/wings inside its own cell with 12% transparent padding, no overlaps across cells. Premium hand-painted 3D stylized fantasy game art, luminous eyes, polished sculptural detail, soft cool blue rim light. Attractive and formidable but child-friendly, no gore, no humans, no writing, numbers, frames, UI, floor, background, or cast shadow. Each elemental variant must have UNIQUE anatomical features and material structure, not recolors. Young nimble cloud-spirit family, compact rounded floating bodies with tiny talons, expressive mischievous faces. METAL: ivory cloud griffin with swept gold feather blades and a silver beak. WOOD: mint cloud deer with branching leafy antlers and a fluffy moss mane. WATER: sapphire cloud manta with transparent fin ears and curling water tail. FIRE: warm coral cloud fox with flame ears and ember curls. EARTH: sandy cloud ram with sandstone curled horns and floating ochre pebbles.
